data.name: Dheeman
data.gender_notes: Dheeman is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhee’ meaning ‘wisdom’ and ‘manas’ meaning ‘mind’. The name Dheeman signifies a powerful and radiant mind. In Hindu mythology, Dheeman is also the name of a sage who attained immense wisdom and spiritual power. The name Dheeman carries the meaning “Powerful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dheeman usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying wisdom and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Dheeman belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dheeman total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dheeman carries a rich cultural heritage and significance in Hinduism. It reflects the admiration for wisdom and knowledge which has always been an integral part of Indian culture and philosophy. This name is also reminiscent of ancient seers and sages, adding an air of reverence and respect.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Dheeman holds immense significance. The word 'Dhee' symbolizes a sharp and profound intellect while 'Manas' represents the mind. This name thus denotes one who has attained a state of deep wisdom and understanding. In the spiritual journey, knowledge and wisdom are considered essential to enlightenment and self-realization. Thus, being named Dheeman is a reminder of the constant pursuit of knowledge and wisdom in one's life, leading to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
